test_title: PYST 7 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The next stage for the banking sector has been set up, with proposed relaxation **of normal** for foreign direct investment.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Of norms**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 

• The phrase "**of norms**" is the most appropriate replacement for "normal" in the sentence, as it accurately conveys the intended meaning of the relaxation being applied to the rules or regulations in question. 

• Option 1 ("**To norms**") is incorrect because "to" does not fit the context of the sentence. 

• Option 2 ("**In normal**") is incorrect because "normal" is not the correct word to describe the context of rules or regulations. 

• Option 4 ("**By normal**") is incorrect as it does not convey the intended meaning of relaxation in rules. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"The next stage for the banking sector has been set up, with proposed relaxation of norms for foreign direct investment."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 

• **Option 1: "To norms"** is incorrect as "to" does not suit the context of the sentence. 

• **Option 2: "In normal"** is incorrect because "normal" cannot replace "norms" in this context. 

• **Option 4: "By normal"** is incorrect as it misrepresents the intended meaning of the relaxation in question.
